headline: Identifying FY27 priorities and project planning for the Arts Commission's upcoming workload.
summary: The commission will hear a Grant Committee report and discuss identifying FY27 priorities and project planning. Commissioners are asked to review past project proposals and score preferred projects using the NAC Project Rubric before the meeting.
items: Old Business: Identifying FY27 Priorities and Project Planning
Open Discussion for Commissioners (if time allows)
